6 the guard object is not validated when present
7 [control] the margin 0.15 becomes 0.16: inside the band where every graded scene is decided as at 0.15 and both headroom tests hold
mutants.why: Every graded scene's loss is at most 0.14 percent, 11.5 percent (the one-wide-pass bands scene) or at least 20.5 percent (the realistic captures: 20.57 in the deciding frame of the mismatched-terrain one). The headroom tests keep a quarter of the margin clear of both, so they accept a margin from 1.25 times 11.48 percent to 20.57 percent over 1.25, that is 0.144 to 0.164, and every other test decides the scenes the same way anywhere from 0.13 to 0.19. 0.16 is inside the band, so no test may tell it from 0.15; the claim ends at 0.164.
